tools.name: Forecast_crypto_and_fiat_currency_exchange_rates_Currency_rates_for_1_bank_Histo
tools.description:
Free subscribe plan available! Check it in pricing and subscribe for tests!
**S**o it does - get exchange rates for selected bank on chosen date. Timezone is important!!!

Example 1 - get currency rates provided by ECB(European Central Bank) in Berlin:
`/api/get_all_currencies_values_for_1bank/?country_code=eu&date_yyyy_mm_dd_from=2021-11-15&date_yyyy_mm_dd_till=2021-11-15&bank_id=15&tz=Europe/Berlin`

Example 2, MAIB (private Moldavian bank): `/api/get_all_currencies_values_for_1bank/?country_code=md&date_yyyy_mm_dd_from=2021-11-12&date_yyyy_mm_dd_till=2021-11-12&bank_id=1&tz=Europe/Chisinau`

tools.name: google/tapas-base-finetuned-wikisql-supervised
tools.description: TAPAS is a BERT-like transformers model pretrained on a large corpus of English data from Wikipedia in a self-supervised fashion. It was pretrained with two objectives: Masked language modeling (MLM) and Intermediate pre-training. Fine-tuning is done by adding a cell selection head and aggregation head on top of the pre-trained model, and then jointly train these randomly initialized classification heads with the base model on SQA and WikiSQL.
